description: This Python source file defines classes for managing SSH connections, executing commands, and copying files to/from remote targets. It is used for automating SSH interactions in testing environments, specifically within the OpenEmbedded/Yocto project context.

classes.name: SSHProcess
classes.description: Handles execution of commands over SSH, capturing output, managing timeouts, and logging.

classes.name: SSHControl
classes.description: Provides high-level SSH operations such as running commands, copying files/directories, and deleting remote files/directories.

methods.name: SSHProcess.__init__
methods.description: Initializes SSHProcess with options for subprocess execution.

methods.name: SSHProcess.log
methods.description: Logs messages to a logfile if specified.

methods.name: SSHProcess._run
methods.description: Executes a command with optional timeout and logs output.

methods.name: SSHProcess.run
methods.description: Runs a command, handling exceptions and process cleanup.

methods.name: SSHControl.__init__
methods.description: Initializes SSHControl with target IP, user, port, and configuration.

methods.name: SSHControl.log
methods.description: Logs messages to a logfile if specified.

methods.name: SSHControl._internal_run
methods.description: Executes SSH commands internally, handling status and output.

methods.name: SSHControl.run
methods.description: Runs a command over SSH with configurable timeout.

methods.name: SSHControl.copy_to
methods.description: Copies a local file to the remote target.

methods.name: SSHControl.copy_from
methods.description: Copies a remote file from the target to local.

methods.name: SSHControl.copy_dir_to
methods.description: Recursively copies a local directory to the remote target.

methods.name: SSHControl.delete_files
methods.description: Deletes specified files on the remote target.

methods.name: SSHControl.delete_dir
methods.description: Deletes a directory on the remote target.

methods.name: SSHControl.delete_dir_structure
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory structure on the remote target.
